etymology.historical_story: Sarada is attested on the official Naruto and Boruto website as the name of Sarada Uchiha, the daughter of Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno. This establishes a specific cultural referent, but it does not establish the origin or meaning of every occurrence of sarada. Without source context, assigning this token a Sanskrit, Japanese, or Malay etymology would be speculative.
